The '''captain''' of the ''[[Hold 'Em]]'', a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser]], commanded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] during the [[Battle of Mindor]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] expressed surprise as their ship was hit by a [[gravity bomb]] that killed them and cut the ''Hold 'Em'' in half.<ref name="Mindor" />
